ConnectionStrings.Comment: Local-dev-only default (postgres/postgres on localhost). Production MUST override PostgresConnection via ConnectionStrings__PostgresConnection env var — never commit a real production connection string here.

Jwt.Comment: SecretKey MUST be set via environment variable Jwt__SecretKey or environment-specific config; the app refuses to start without a strong key

FileStorage.Comment: Provider can be 'Local', 'AzureBlob', or 'R2' (Cloudflare). EnableLocalFallback: when true, cloud-storage failures silently fall back to local disk — keep false in production so uploads fail loudly instead of storing files with unservable URLs

R2.Comment: BasePath organizes all uploads under a custom folder (e.g., uploads/Screens/..., uploads/Creatives/...). AccountId/AccessKeyId/SecretAccessKey/PublicUrlBase MUST be set via R2__* environment variables in production — never commit real Cloudflare R2 credentials here.

Email.Comment: Set to false in production to send real emails via SES/SMTP. Override with Email__DevelopmentMode=true env var for local dev.

ComBirds.Comment: Configure via env vars in production. Override with ComBirds__DevelopmentMode=true for local dev.

App.Comment: Frontend base URL for verification links

DefaultVideo.Comment: Universal fallback video URL used when no booking or owner content exists for a slot

GooglePlaces.Comment: Google Places API (New) key for screen auto-tagging - set via GooglePlaces__ApiKey environment variable

Razorpay.Comment: Razorpay API credentials - override in environment-specific config

Payments.Comment: false = campaigns can be booked without paying: the wizard skips the wallet balance check and debit, and creates bookings with PaymentStatus.None so payouts (which only pay out Captured bookings) are not triggered for uncollected money. Set to true once the Razorpay checkout flow is wired into the wizard to restore up-front payment.

Sentry.Comment: Set via Sentry__Dsn environment variable to enable error tracking

Platform.Comment: Platform commission, advance payout percentage, and GST configuration
